WIP GALLERY.

Support Conversation Artworks from File 14 onwards, previous files are the Pin Up of the Ladies.

In most of the Fire Emblem games since Fire Emblem 6 (2001, GBA), the "Support System" is available as a way to explore more the depth of each playable character through the interaction between other few, selected characters.

This gallery is going to offer Illustrated Reiterpretations of every support between the characters from Fire Emblem 12: New Mystery of The Emblem.

In this and latter games, there is a newly added custom-made character called "Avatar", the POV character that is involved (up to a point or completely) in the story of the game.

In this gallery specifically, gallery will be split between:

1. Avatar Character (Female Version) supports (only the most interesting ones)
2. Supports between the already estabilished characters that have a connection between each other

The following FE entries (only 1 between the C,B,A support levels) will be also featured in future correspective gallery each, and I will add a link for each entry:

FE5 (1999) (Forseti's Cut Mod) https://e-hentai.org/g/3776124/0f9190fbac/

FE8 (2004) https://e-hentai.org/g/3768675/4ba14d2eed/
FE9 (2005) https://e-hentai.org/g/3776025/513ea39574/
FE215 (2017)

The support system exists in latter games as well, but the writing in most of them is subpar compared to the aforementioned entries (too bad, because some of the characters are very interesting by themselves).
